item.title: Big Rab Mulheron Steps into The Spotlight as Inverness Town House Prepares for a Night of Highland Laughter
item.description: Big Rab Mulheron returns to Inverness Town House as one of the Highlands most loved comics, bringing decades of storytelling, fearless humour and a genuine connection with audiences to a Christmas show that celebrates the talent reshaping the region’s growing comedy scene.The post Big Rab Mulheron Steps into The Spotlight as Inverness Town House Prepares for a Night of Highland Laughter appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Snow White Shines at Eden Court With a Magical Highland Panto Full of Heart and Laughter
item.description: Snow White at Eden Court delivers a warm and joyful Highland panto full of laughter, music and festive magic, offering families a night of real connection as a talented cast brings heart, humour and creativity to one of the season’s must see shows.The post Snow White Shines at Eden Court With a Magical Highland Panto Full of Heart and Laughter appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Man Charged Following Death of Iain Gordon Macfarlane in Inverness
item.description: Iain Gordon Macfarlane, 32, from the Ullapool area, has been named locally after his death in Strathspey Place in Inverness, with police confirming a 52 year old man has been charged and that the incident was contained to the property.The post Man Charged Following Death of Iain Gordon Macfarlane in Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Amber Wind Warning Issued as Storm Bram Approaches Scotland
item.description: An amber wind warning has been issued as Storm Bram approaches Scotland, with high winds and heavy rain expected to disrupt travel from Tuesday afternoon into Wednesday. Officials urge people to plan ahead, check routes and prepare for difficult conditions.The post Amber Wind Warning Issued as Storm Bram Approaches Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ariane Burgess Welcomes Decision to Block New Salmon Farm on Lewis
item.description: Ariane Burgess MSP has welcomed the decision to refuse a salmon farm at North Gravir, supporting island fishers who warned the development would displace boats from long established grounds and threaten the livelihoods that have sustained families for generations. The post Ariane Burgess Welcomes Decision to Block New Salmon Farm on Lewis appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Character Home With Sea Views Offers Space and Flexibility in Heart of Cromarty
item.description: A spacious five bedroom character home on Cromarty’s historic Church Street has come to market, offering sea views, flexible living space and potential for a self contained apartment. A rare chance to buy in one of the Highlands’ most sought after coastal towns.The post Character Home With Sea Views Offers Space and Flexibility in Heart of Cromarty appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Young Artists Lead Dingwall into 800th Anniversary With Winning Logo
item.description: Dingwall is preparing to celebrate eight hundred years as a Royal Burgh with a year of community events led by young artists whose work will front the celebrations, marking a milestone that brings the town’s heritage, creativity and future together.The post Young Artists Lead Dingwall into 800th Anniversary With Winning Logo appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Ben Nevis Holiday Park Celebrates Third Successive Tourism Award
item.description: Ben Nevis Holiday Park has been named Scotland’s Best Large Relax and Explore destination for the third year running, reflecting exceptional guest reviews and reinforcing the Highlands as one of the UK’s most reliable and welcoming staycation regions.The post Ben Nevis Holiday Park Celebrates Third Successive Tourism Award appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Head Brewer Appointed at Inverness Brewstillery
item.description: Uile bheist in Inverness has appointed experienced brewer Charlotte Cook as its new Head Brewer ahead of a major year for the city, bringing fresh creativity and ambition as the brewery prepares for rising visitor numbers and new opportunities.The post New Head Brewer Appointed at Inverness Brewstillery appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Highland Concerns as British Transport Police Trial Live Facial Recognition in London Stations
item.description: A new police trial of Live Facial Recognition technology in London rail stations is being watched closely in the Highlands, where privacy and freedom remain prized, as British Transport Police assesses whether the system improves safety or raises new concerns for travellers.The post Highland Concerns as British Transport Police Trial Live Facial Recognition in London Stations appeared first on The Highland Times.
